scope: npm production, development, and build-time dependency reports
releaseDecision: allowed only when the production audit contains no advisory except the two exact image-size advisories mitigated and regression-tested by the version-pinned local source patch
rationale: Upstream image-size has no patched release as of the review date; npm's proposed React Native 0.72 downgrade would remove the required API 36 and 16 KiB platform baseline.
The install-time patch rejects non-advancing ICNS, JXL, and HEIF box lengths and the release gate executes malicious-input probes with a hard timeout.

nanoid, brace-expansion, js-yaml, fast-xml-parser, and the React Native CLI are independently moved to fixed compatible releases. Unsafe automatic npm audit fix is forbidden, the full graph remains visible in CI, and this exception expires for re-review.
requiredControls: npm run audit:production must reject every unreviewed advisory and every unpatched image-size installation
npm ci must apply the version-pinned source patch reproducibly
the full npm audit report must be uploaded by CI
release artifacts must pass the APK/AAB content, signature, ABI, alignment, and dependency-closure gates
